name: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% of the machinery cost or ₹10,00,000/-, whichever is less.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be involved in agriculture-related activities. 1. The applicant must intend to purchase machinery for value addition.
